supplementarySourceVerification.method: Five targeted automated audio-to-text checks completed before inventory freezing, read against full canonical captions. No direct human listening or diarization. No additional inventory attribution triggers. Canonical quotations remain uncorrected exact caption excerpts.
supplementarySourceVerification.finalClipResponseLimitation: The longest clip response ends mid-sentence; review uses only returned text together with complete captions and does not claim a complete independent transcript of that clip.

cost.basis: Duration-based estimate for five successfully returned calls totaling 1940 seconds; actual usage retained in source results. No failed or transport-uncertain paid calls.
